verdict.rationale: mParticle documents per-destination controls through Data Privacy Controls and consent filters. These let forwarding rules block data to an output, for example 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present'. A docs page title also references transforming data as it leaves mParticle. However, the evidence never mentions hashing, masking, or attribute-level filtering of sensitive fields, so only coarse per-destination flow control is shown. Missing for 10: per-destination hashing of PII, masking of sensitive values, documented field-level attribute filtering per output, substantive transformation docs beyond a title, independent corroboration.
